WEBSITE INFORMATION

A few helpful details.

About inspiration, quotations and event enquiries.

Inspiration and service descriptions

Images are AI-generated visual concepts. They illustrate possible styling directions and do not represent completed client work or a guarantee that a particular setup is available.

Packages and quotations

Package descriptions are starting points for discussion. Final services, decoration materials, venue requirements, availability, prices and any additional costs must be confirmed directly in a personalised quote.

Enquiries and bookings

Sending an enquiry does not reserve a date or confirm a booking. Booking, payment, changes and cancellation arrangements will be discussed and agreed directly with the team before you proceed. This website does not accept payments.

Third-party services

WhatsApp and Instagram are operated by their respective providers. Their terms apply when you use those services.

Contact

Please contact Purple Fox if you need clarification about an event proposal or this website.
